mostWorthwhile.text: Making fossils from shells and sediment was satisfying and illuminating: the result explained both preservation and why the fossil record is incomplete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to preserve algae felt least productive; sediment seemed plausible, but algae had no available combinations.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the algae route ended immediately while a separate animal route led to shells and fossils.

arbitrary.text: Adding membranes to cell colonies to produce multicellular life initially felt somewhat arbitrary, although the result explained membranes' role in cell contact and signalling.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose to see how the living world develops further: the branching paths and concise scientific qualifications made the discoveries interesting.
